Therefore, the optimal ranking is z > x > y > w. This ensures that if z is obtainable, I get z. If z is not obtainable but x is, I get x. If neither z nor x is obtainable, I get my next best choice, y. Finally, if none of z, x, or y is obtainable, I get w.
